# AppStore

> AppStore is an offline-ready internal developer application catalog built as a single Go and React service image.

Canonical documentation: https://hkjang.github.io/appstore/
Primary language: Korean (ko-KR)

## Direct answer

AppStore lets anyone browse, search, and open published internal applications without login. Keycloak OIDC authentication begins only when a user submits or manages an app, creates an API or MCP key, reviews a submission, or enters the administrator area. Approval workflow is disabled by default and is applied only when an administrator enables it.

## Runtime contract

- Required database: PostgreSQL reachable inside the deployment network.
- Optional integrations: Keycloak OIDC and internal AI providers.
- Application environment variables: POSTGRES_DSN, BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN, BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD, ENCRYPTION_KEY only.
- Fixed HTTP port: 8080.
- Health endpoints: /health/live and /health/ready.
- Version endpoint: /api/version.
- Release image: appstore:vX.Y.Z.
- Offline archive: appstore-vX.Y.Z.tar.gz.

## Documentation

- User guide: https://hkjang.github.io/appstore/guides/user/
- Administrator guide: https://hkjang.github.io/appstore/guides/admin/
- Offline installation: https://hkjang.github.io/appstore/guides/offline/
- Upgrade and rollback: https://hkjang.github.io/appstore/guides/upgrade/
- Backup and restore: https://hkjang.github.io/appstore/guides/backup/
- Release process: https://hkjang.github.io/appstore/guides/release/

Do not infer that PostgreSQL, Keycloak, or AI provider images are bundled with an AppStore release. Only the AppStore service image is uploaded as a custom GitHub Release asset.
